progress.$description: ProgressBar: a line (the track, the bar, the rest of the track, a stop dot, a runner, a wave) or a circle (a ring and an arc), and its caption.

active-gap.$description: Space between the end of the bar and the rest of the track (0: the rest starts where the bar ends).

dot-size.$description: The stop dot at the end of the track (the `stop` unit), across and along.

stop-inset.$description: From the end of the track to the dot.

runner-length.$description: The part that runs along the track while the value is not known, as a share of the track.

runner-duration.$description: One run along the track; follows the motion durations, so reduced motion stops it.

sm.$description: The bar per size; `rest-thickness`: the rest of the track.

wave-amplitude.$description: How far the bar swings to each side of the track while it is a wave (0: a straight bar). The track keeps room for it.

wave-speed.$description: How long the wave takes to travel one wave length; follows the motion durations, so reduced motion keeps it still.

wave-direction.$description: Where the wave travels: `forward` (toward the end) or `backward` (toward the start).

wave-start.$description: The share of the work done from which the bar is a wave (it is straight while shorter).

wave-end.$description: The share from which it is straight again.

wave-grow-duration.$description: How long the wave takes to grow in or flatten out.

sm.$description: The circle (`shape="circle"`) per size: across, without the room for a wave.

ring-active-gap.$description: Space between each end of the arc and the ring (0: the ring runs on under the arc).

ring-runner-length.$description: The arc that turns while the value is not known, as a share of the ring.

ring-turn-duration.$description: One turn of that arc; follows the motion durations, so reduced motion stops it.

ring-wave-amplitude.$description: The wave of the arc, as `wave-*` for the bar (0: a smooth arc); its length is fitted so whole waves go round.

accent.$description: The bar, the runner, the dot, the wave and the arc per tone (each unit reads it as `var(--_tone)`); `-subtle`: the track a runner runs along.

track.$description: The band the bar fills: drawn where the design shows the track as one band under the bar (it is as high as the bar and, with a wave, the room the wave swings in).

bar.$description: The part done, from the start to the value; while the value is not known, the whole track the runner runs along (in the tone's subtle colour).

rest.$description: The rest of the track as its own line, from `active-gap` after the bar to the end, centred on the bar (it can be thinner).

stop.$description: A dot at the end of the track, centred on it; the bar pushes it out as it comes near.

runner.$description: The part that runs along the track while the value is not known.

wave.$description: The bar drawn as a line that swings (`wave-*`), where the language gives it an amplitude: its colour is the line's.

ring.$description: The circle's track: the ring the arc goes round (its colour is the line's), with `ring-active-gap` beside each end of the arc.

arc.$description: The circle's part done, from the top round to the value (a wave where `ring-wave-amplitude` is given); while the value is not known, an arc that turns.

label.$description: The caption that names the bar.
